name: Ice Age
description: Adds Ice Age as an independently enabled expansion. Its stone medallion lives under Deck Builder Extras, leaving the original set strip unchanged. Reprints remain the same name-based playable cards.
rules_note: No other numbered pack is required. The game ships the executable card rules; this ZIP supplies checked metadata and artwork only. Digital adaptations: Balduvian Shaman changes colors only on the five colored Circles of Protection, and Game of Chaos stops after 30 flips per resolution. See the cards' rules text and Help.
